text:
maria_sales: AtlasCorp legal just pinged asking for the POC scope and who will own the security questionnaire. Can we align quickly?
dan_solutions: I'll own the scope doc. Proposed success criteria: 1) integration completed (SDK sample runs) 2) 200ms p95 for simple chat at low concurrency 3) embedding recall > 88% on their testset 4) documented retry semantics. Any objections?
tariq_engineer: Slight tweak: let's say 250ms p95 to be safer given their average prompt length. Also note that hosted sandbox will be throttled: default quota 250 req/min and 8 concurrent streams. We'll provide a temporary API key tied to the POC org.
amy_se: SDK guidance: include example for streaming with resumable IDs. Example: ``from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="POC_KEY")
with client.chat.stream(model="rwd-large") as s:
    for chunk in s:
        process(chunk)`` Call out that websocket streams need a sticky client id for resume.
sec-bot: Security: I'll take the questionnaire. Need to confirm data retention expectations and whether we need SOC2 evidence. Typical turnaround is 72 hours once we get the filled form.
maria_sales: Great. Dan — can you also put in the scoping doc the pricing expectations for a 2-week POC and an option for a paid Dedicated trial if they want higher throughput?
dan_solutions: Yes. I'll include 2 pricing lines: hosted trial (metered tokens + fixed POC fee) and a one-month Dedicated trial estimate (capacity + setup).
Tariq_engineer: For retries: default policy in SDK is 3 retries with exponential backoff starting at 200ms; mention that streaming reconnections are automatic and use a resume token.
aman_solutions: (added) Also ask Atlas for their expected queries per user in demo so we can size quotas appropriately.
maria_sales: Thanks all — I'll collect these and send to Atlas.
